description: This file contains unit tests for TLS (Transport Layer Security) support in Orleans connections, including certificate creation, configuration of TLS options for clients and silos, and end-to-end testing of secure communication using self-signed certificates. It defines test classes, configuration helpers, and a test grain for verifying data transmission over TLS.

classes.name: TlsConnectionTests
classes.description: Contains tests and configuration helpers for verifying TLS connection support in Orleans, including certificate generation, client/silo TLS setup, and end-to-end encrypted communication testing.

classes.name: TlsClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures TLS options for Orleans clients to use mutual TLS with specified certificates and protocols.

classes.name: TlsServerConfigurator
classes.description: Configures TLS options for Orleans silos to support secure connections with certificates.

methods.name: CanCreateCertificates
methods.description: Tests the creation, encoding, and decoding of self-signed certificates to ensure correctness.

methods.name: TlsEndToEnd
methods.description: Performs an end-to-end test of TLS-encrypted communication with various certificate configurations, verifying data integrity and proper connection setup.
